about.title: What you can do here
about.plan: DrawMyTrip turns a trip idea into a route map. Add cities and nights, choose how you travel between them, and see the whole route on one interactive map. You can <plan>plan it with AI</plan> or <build>build it by hand</build>.
about.ai: The AI planner asks three questions: where you are going, for how long and at what pace. It returns a draft route that you can change stop by stop. Each stop has notes on what to see, where to eat, where to stay and how to get around, and every leg shows the transport mode and travel time.
about.share: When the route is ready, share it with one link, download it as a poster or print the itinerary. Guest maps are free, need no account and hold up to {max} stops. A shared link stays live for {days} days after its last visit. <how>Read how it works</how>.

faq.title: Before you write
faq.lost: Lost a map? Unshared maps live only in the browser where you made them, so we can’t restore them.
faq.expired: Link stopped working? Shared maps expire {days} days after their last view. Share the map again from My Maps for a fresh link.
faq.stops: Need more than {max} stops? Longer itineraries are coming with sign-up. For now, split a long trip into two maps.

free.a: Yes. Guest maps are free, with up to {max} stops each.

account.a: No. Your maps are saved in this browser. Sharing creates a link anyone can open, no sign-up needed.

links.q: How long do shared links last?
links.a: A shared map stays live for {days} days after its last view, so links in active use keep working.

ai.a: No. It drafts a sensible route, but check transport, prices, visas and opening hours before you book.

data.a: Unshared maps never leave your browser. See the <link>Privacy notice</link> for what shared maps and the AI planner send to us.
